text_description: Full-length runway look in a soft ivory palette, built around a cropped, fluffy-textured jacket worn over a voluminous layered dress or skirt. The jacket has a deep open V neckline with no visible collar, rounded slightly padded-looking shoulders, long sleeves, and a short hem ending around the natural waist; its surface appears densely tufted or curly, giving a plush boucle-like effect, with a small dark point at the lower V suggesting a visible fastening or accent. Beneath it, a pale cream sheer tulle skirt/dress flares outward from the waist into a buoyant A-line shape, with translucent gauzy layers over a more opaque underlayer; the hem is irregular and dimensional, shorter at the front around the knee and falling longer at the sides/back, with clustered lace-like or ruffled textured bands visible near the lower edge. The legs are bare, emphasizing the airy high-low proportion of the skirt. Footwear consists of delicate pale pink or nude strappy high-heeled sandals with open toes and slim ankle straps. The styling is romantic and tactile, mixing plush winter texture on top with light, frothy, semi-sheer volume below.
key_elements: deep open neckline with small dark fastening/accent
layered sheer cream tulle skirt or dress
